Details 
 Ashland hat is a classic ranch hat built for everyday wear with clean western style and a comfortable snapback fit. Designed as a versatile country hat, the Ashland features embroidered Kimes lettering across the front with the signature horns logo on the side, giving this western hat a timeless look that never goes out of style. Simple, durable, and easy to wear, this ranch hat is made for work, travel, and daily use.
 The structured design helps this country hat hold its shape while staying comfortable all day. The adjustable snapback closure allows for a secure fit, making this western hat a dependable choice whether you are at the barn, on the road, or out for the day. Lightweight but durable, the Ashland is built to handle everyday wear without losing its clean look.
 With its classic western design, this ranch hat pairs easily with your favorite Kimes Ranch jeans, tees, hoodies, and button downs. Made for work, outdoors, and casual wear, the Ashland delivers comfort, durability, and signature ranch style you can wear anywhere.
 Fabric: Cotton Twill Wool Blend
 Fit: Adjustable Snapback | Mid-Profile | Curved Bill
 Details: Embroidered Logo
